why.planner: Opus 5.5 at medium effort sits on the Artificial Analysis speed/intelligence Pareto frontier (index 51, 21.7 s end to end, Oct 2026); runs on Khalid's Claude subscription via the official CLI.
why.planner_effort: medium is the Pareto-frontier point; live planner median 5-11 s.
why.executor_effort: low: scored 10/12 at a median 45.665 s; medium scored 10 at 68.905 s (fastest effort within 1 item(s) of the best) [calibration calibrate-mlx-mlx-community-qwen3-8-27b-4bit-20261031-022745.json]
why.executor_thinking: auto: the value the sub preset has always run with. No effect through the claude-code CLI today, which passes only --effort.
why.plan: lazy: the planner's first call is the slowest wait (~11 s median); lazy planning needed the planner only 3 times across 15 tasks in round 4.
why.verify: auto: always-on verification cost ~100 s on weather-hub in round 1 by distrusting correct work; auto verifies only after escalations or long runs.
why.max_step_turns: untuned: the default, never measured against alternatives
why.max_escalations: untuned: the default, never measured against alternatives
why.use_ax: on: element-id probes hit 8/8, acting through ids 8/8 times [calibration calibrate-mlx-mlx-community-qwen3-8-27b-4bit-20261031-022745.json]
why.auto_observe: on: the executor never spends a call asking to look; one fresh observation per turn with actions.
why.max_long_edge: 1470 px: 8/8; 1280 px: 8/8; 1024 px: 8/8 grounding hits. 1024 px is the smallest without losing accuracy (~49% of full-size visual tokens). [calibration calibrate-mlx-mlx-community-qwen3-8-27b-4bit-20261031-022745.json]
why.image_format: untuned: the default, never measured against alternatives
why.keep_images: no effect via the CLI (it manages its own context). untuned: the default, never measured against alternatives
why.outline_max_lines: untuned: the default, never measured against alternatives
why.outline_max_chars: untuned: the default, never measured against alternatives
why.compact_outline: on: removes duplicate row/cell/text lines; fixed (frame containment) after it dropped Finder's file icons.
why.settle_timeout: untuned: the default, never measured against alternatives
why.evidence_gate: on: caught the Finder false done (rename field showed 'Pilot Folder', disk had 'untitled folder'); fires on write tasks only, ~2 s.
why.loop_window: untuned: the default, never measured against alternatives
why.budget_warning: untuned: the default, never measured against alternatives
why.nudge_on_text_end: untuned: the default, never measured against alternatives
why.no_change_note: untuned: the default, never measured against alternatives
why.await_editable: on: fixed the cmd+shift+n typing race in Finder and the wrong-field typing in the job form.
why.editable_timeout: untuned: the default, never measured against alternatives
why.paste_threshold: untuned: the default, never measured against alternatives
why.executor_rules: all: `exact_url` added after the stale-tab failure (drag-sort round 2), `impossible`/`done` after the false done; this set scored 15/15 twice. Safety rules are always included and are not in this list.
why.executor_coords: pixels: grounding probes hit 8/8 with pixels coordinates vs 6/8 with the other convention. [calibration calibrate-mlx-mlx-community-qwen3-8-27b-4bit-20261031-022745.json]
why.context_budget: 20000: executor input grew 6.8k -> 51k tokens over 14 calls on the job form (each observing turn adds about 5k; old element lists are stale a turn later), and calls of 30k+ took a median 11.0 s vs 4.4 s under 15k. A restart passes the whole step's actions and the current screen; it fires on the largest single request's size, and only when history makes up half the budget.
